decision_changed: Attention sites passing here would mean the resid-only localization reported for five behaviours is a consequence of long cue distance in my stimuli and not evidence that those variables are carried only late; every one of those localization claims would need restating. A resid-only profile again would leave them standing and make late carriage the better-supported reading.
matched_prior_claims: circuits/fast_screens/narrative_tense_past_vs_present_v2_result.json selects resid:18 with passing sites resid:12-18 and no attention or module site passing, with the tense cue roughly ten tokens before the patched position.
The same resid-only profile holds for bracket_positive_control, sentence_terminal, quote_parity and correlative_state, all of which place a long shared tail between the cue and the prediction.
By contrast numbered_list, numeric_sequence and task14 screens DO pass attention sites, and their strongest is attn:08.
circuits/fast_screen_ledger.jsonl records no screen that varies cue-to-prediction distance while holding the behaviour fixed.
novelty_delta: Extends narrative_tense by varying ONE thing: the distance between the tense cue and the patched final position. A1, A2 and P lose the long shared tail so the cue sits two to four tokens before the prediction; the control is held BYTE-IDENTICAL to v2. The instrument patches only the final input token, so a head that writes the state at an EARLIER position and lets it flow forward is invisible to it. If the resid-only profile is a fact about these behaviours, the short-cue screen should still pass only residual sites. If it is a property of the design, attention sites should now pass, because the state has to be read at or near the patched position.
